summary.zh: 从采购申请到付款核销，跨需求、采购、供应商、仓库、财务五个部门。
summary.en: From purchase requisition to payment clearing, across five departments: requester, procurement, supplier, warehouse, and finance.

desc.zh: 需求部门发起采购需求，填写物料、数量、预算与期望到货时间，提交多级审批。
desc.en: The requesting department raises a purchase need — material, quantity, budget, and expected delivery — and submits it for multi-level approval.

desc.zh: 采购员依据已批准的申请向供应商下单，锁定价格、交期与合同条款。
desc.en: The buyer places an order with the supplier based on the approved requisition, locking in price, lead time, and contract terms.

check.zh: 供应商资质 · 价格/合同

desc.zh: 按合同约定支付预付款或定金（也可后付）。出纳发起付款并经财务审批。
desc.en: Pay the deposit or advance per the contract (post-payment is also possible). The cashier initiates payment with finance approval.

check.zh: 付款审批 · 银行回单

desc.zh: 供应商开具发票，财务做发票校验：与采购订单、入库单进行三单匹配。
desc.en: The supplier issues an invoice; finance verifies it via three-way matching against the PO and goods receipt.

check.zh: 三单匹配 · 税额/查验

desc.zh: 货物到场，仓库按订单验收并登记实收数量，质检合格后正式入库。
desc.en: Goods arrive; the warehouse inspects against the order, records the actual quantity, and stocks them after passing QC.

desc.zh: 三单匹配通过后，系统自动生成应付账款，记入供应商往来与账期。
desc.en: Once three-way matching passes, the system auto-creates the payable and posts it to the supplier ledger and aging.

check.zh: 金额=入库×单价 · 账期

desc.zh: 实际付款与应付账款逐笔核销，预付款冲抵，结清供应商往来余额。
desc.en: Actual payments are cleared against payables one by one, prepayments offset, settling the supplier balance.

check.zh: 应付余额归零 · 对账

summary.zh: 从客户下单到收款核销（示例流程，可替换为你们的真实流程）。
summary.en: From customer order to payment clearing (example flow — replace with your real process).

desc.zh: 客户提交采购需求或下达订单。
desc.en: The customer submits a purchase request or places an order.

desc.zh: 销售确认订单，安排排产/备货。
desc.en: Sales confirms the order and arranges production/stock.

desc.zh: 仓库按订单拣货、发货并出库。
desc.en: The warehouse picks, ships, and issues per the order.

desc.zh: 财务向客户开具发票。
desc.en: Finance issues an invoice to the customer.

desc.zh: 收到客户回款。
desc.en: Payment is received from the customer.

desc.zh: 收款与应收逐笔核销。
desc.en: Receipts are cleared against receivables one by one.

summary.zh: 员工报销从提交到付款归档（示例流程，可替换）。
summary.en: Employee reimbursement from submission to payment and archiving (example flow, replaceable).

desc.zh: 员工上传票据、填写明细并提交。
desc.en: The employee uploads receipts, fills in details, and submits.

desc.zh: 直属主管审核金额与事由。
desc.en: The direct manager reviews the amount and reason.

desc.zh: 财务复核票据真伪与科目。
desc.en: Finance verifies receipt authenticity and accounts.

desc.zh: 财务向员工付款。
desc.en: Finance pays the employee.

desc.zh: 生成会计凭证并归档。
desc.en: Generate the accounting voucher and archive it.

summary.zh: 客户询价 → 订单审批 → 出库发运签收 → 开票挂应收 → 回款核销 → 成本结转与毛利分析，端到端业财闭环。
summary.en: Inquiry → order approval → ship & sign-off → invoice & post receivable → collection & clearing → cost carry-forward and margin analysis: an end-to-end business-finance loop.

desc.zh: 客户通过询盘或老客户回购，触发新一轮销售。
desc.en: A customer inquiry or repeat purchase triggers a new sales cycle.

desc.zh: 销售员按报价模板与价格策略生成正式报价单。
desc.en: The salesperson generates a formal quote using the template and pricing strategy.

check.zh: 税率 / 有效期 / 付款条件

desc.zh: 客户回签报价单或发来 PO，构成订单依据。
desc.en: The customer signs back the quote or sends a PO as the order basis.

desc.zh: 录入订单，自动校验信用、库存、最低售价。
desc.en: Enter the order; the system auto-checks credit, stock, and floor price.

check.zh: 信用 / 库存 / 最低价

desc.zh: 按金额、折扣、信用占用走多级审批。
desc.en: Multi-level approval based on amount, discount, and credit usage.

check.zh: 审批流 / 黑名单 / 价格区间

desc.zh: 审批未通过，退回销售员修改或终止业务。
desc.en: If rejected, return to the salesperson for revision or terminate.

desc.zh: 审批通过同时冻结客户信用额度（备查簿）。
desc.en: On approval, freeze the customer's credit line (memo ledger).

check.zh: 占用应收信用 · 非账务

desc.zh: 订单状态变更为「已确认」，可出库可承诺。
desc.en: Order status becomes "Confirmed" — shippable and committable.

desc.zh: WMS 生成拣货任务，PDA 扫码绑定批次 / SN。
desc.en: WMS creates picking tasks; PDA scans bind batch/SN.

desc.zh: 复核员二次扫描，确认数量与批次正确。
desc.en: A checker rescans to confirm quantity and batch.

desc.zh: 过账即扣减库存、按 WAC/FIFO 计算出库成本。
desc.en: Posting deducts stock and computes COGS by WAC/FIFO.

check.zh: 借发出商品 / 贷库存商品

desc.zh: 对接 TMS / 三方物流，记录承运商与运单号。
desc.en: Integrate TMS / 3PL; record carrier and waybill number.

desc.zh: 客户验收无误，状态由在途变为已签收。
desc.en: The customer accepts; status moves from in-transit to received.

desc.zh: 财务开具增值税发票，金额与订单一致。
desc.en: Finance issues a VAT invoice matching the order amount.

check.zh: 借应收 / 贷收入 + 税金

desc.zh: 总账新增应收余额，进入账龄统计。
desc.en: GL adds the AR balance and starts aging.

desc.zh: 客户按账期付款，可部分 / 合并 / 跨发票。
desc.en: The customer pays per terms — partial / merged / cross-invoice.

desc.zh: 银企直连或回单导入，自动识别去重。
desc.en: Bank link or receipt import with auto de-duplication.

check.zh: 客户 / 币种 / 去重

desc.zh: 出纳登记收款单，已指定挂应收 / 未指定挂预收。
desc.en: The cashier records the receipt; assigned → AR, unassigned → advance.

check.zh: 借银行 / 贷应收或预收
check.en: Dr bank / Cr AR or advance

desc.zh: 支持 1:1 / 1:N / N:N 核销，尾差入折扣 / 汇兑。
desc.en: Supports 1:1 / 1:N / N:N clearing; residuals to discount / FX.

desc.zh: 月末批量：发出商品 → 主营业务成本。
desc.en: Month-end batch: goods shipped → cost of sales.

check.zh: 借成本 / 贷发出商品

desc.zh: 按客户 / 产品 / 销售员 / 区域多维分析毛利。
desc.en: Analyze margin by customer / product / rep / region.

desc.zh: 收入、成本、回款全部确认，本笔闭环。
desc.en: Revenue, cost, and collection all confirmed — the deal closes.

summary.zh: 合同作约束、订单唯一执行；含路径 A（关联合同）/ 路径 B（直接下单）、三种收入确认方式与回款核销分支。
summary.en: Contracts set the constraints; orders are the sole execution. Includes Path A (linked contract) / Path B (direct order), three revenue-recognition methods, and collection-clearing branches.

desc.zh: 框架协议：约定价、上限量、有效期，不直接执行。
desc.en: A framework: agreed price, max quantity, validity — not directly executed.

check.zh: 1 合同 → N 订单 · 单价 ≤ 合同价

desc.zh: 无合同场景直接选客户物料建单（路径 B）。
desc.en: With no contract, build an order straight from customer + items (Path B).

desc.zh: 系统内唯一执行单据，两路来源汇入。
desc.en: The sole execution document; both paths feed into it.

check.zh: 来源 / 收入确认方式

desc.zh: 必配：按发货 / 按验收 / 按节点。
desc.en: Mandatory: by shipment / by acceptance / by milestone.

desc.zh: 按金额、折扣、信用走多级审批。
desc.en: Multi-level approval by amount, discount, and credit.

check.zh: 审批流 / 信用 / 价格区间

desc.zh: 审批通过同步冻结客户信用额度。
desc.en: On approval, freeze the customer's credit line.

desc.zh: 状态变已确认，可对仓库下达发货指令。
desc.en: Status becomes confirmed; shipping can be ordered to the warehouse.

desc.zh: 由订单生成发货单，通知仓库可发货。
desc.en: Generated from the order to tell the warehouse to ship.

check.zh: 关联订单 / 计划日期

desc.zh: 核查库存，分批或一次性发货，绑批次 / SN。
desc.en: Check stock; ship in batches or at once, binding batch/SN.

desc.zh: 过账扣库存、按 WAC/FIFO 计成本。
desc.en: Posting deducts stock and computes cost by WAC/FIFO.

check.zh: 借发出商品 / 贷库存

desc.zh: 出库后库存数量与价值双向变更。
desc.en: After issue, both stock quantity and value change.

desc.zh: 按订单收入确认方式触发记账。
desc.en: Booking is triggered per the order's revenue method.

check.zh: 借应收 / 贷收入 + 税金

desc.zh: 总账新增应收余额，进入账龄统计。
desc.en: GL adds the AR balance and starts aging.

desc.zh: 发出商品 → 主营业务成本，收入成本配比。
desc.en: Goods shipped → cost of sales, matching revenue.

check.zh: 借成本 / 贷发出商品

desc.zh: 销售登记客户回款流水，提交财务核对。
desc.en: Sales records the customer payment and submits to finance.

check.zh: 关联订单 / 银行流水号

desc.zh: 核对银行回单，判断核销路径。
desc.en: Verify the bank receipt and decide the clearing path.

desc.zh: 已发货 → 冲抵应收，余额减少（多对多核销）。
desc.en: If shipped → offset AR, balance down (N:N clearing).

desc.zh: 未发货 → 形成预收款（负债），待履约核销。
desc.en: If not shipped → an advance (liability), cleared on fulfillment.

desc.zh: 应收收齐、收入成本确认，订单关闭。
desc.en: AR collected, revenue and cost confirmed, order closed.

summary.zh: 采购申请审批 → 代办池汇总分配 → 下单审批 / 付款 → 到货 → 免检 / 质检分流 → 合格 / 让步 / 拒收三路裁决入库。
summary.en: Requisition approval → to-do pool aggregation → order approval / payment → arrival → exemption / inspection split → pass / concession / reject three-way receipt.

desc.zh: 新建采购，填标题 / 优先级 / 关联项目 / 建议供应商。
desc.en: Create a requisition: title / priority / linked project / suggested supplier.

check.zh: 关联项目 / 客户 / 合同

desc.zh: 单个手动添加，或从已签销售订单获取。
desc.en: Add items manually or pull from signed sales orders.

desc.zh: 按金额、关联项目、申请部门走多级审批。
desc.en: Multi-level approval by amount, project, and requesting dept.

desc.zh: 集中处理已审批物料行，可分组筛选。
desc.en: Centrally handle approved item lines with grouping and filters.

check.zh: 批量处理 / 智能分配

desc.zh: 同供应商一键下单，或多供应商合并下单。
desc.en: One-click order per supplier, or merge across suppliers.

desc.zh: 由代办池分配生成，可一对多供应商。
desc.en: Generated from the pool; can be one-to-many across suppliers.

desc.zh: 按金额、供应商等级触发多级审批。
desc.en: Multi-level approval by amount and supplier tier.

desc.zh: 到货前预付，或到货后 / 分期支付货款。
desc.en: Prepay before arrival, or pay after / in installments.

check.zh: 借预付 / 应付 · 贷银行

desc.zh: 供应商备货发运，回传物流单号与到达日。
desc.en: The supplier ships and returns waybill number and ETA.

desc.zh: 录入到货数量 / 批次 / 物流，按免检属性分流。
desc.en: Log arrival quantity / batch / logistics; route by exemption attribute.

desc.zh: 按物料档案「是否免检」自动判断。
desc.en: Auto-decided by the item's "inspection-exempt" flag.

check.zh: 免检直入 / 需检待检

desc.zh: 免检物料跳过质检，直接生成入库单。
desc.en: Exempt items skip QC and go straight to a receipt note.

desc.zh: 需检物料进独立库位，不可销售 / 领用。
desc.en: Items needing QC enter a separate location, not sellable/issuable.

desc.zh: 系统按待检库存自动生成并分配质检员。
desc.en: Auto-generated from pending stock and assigned to an inspector.

desc.zh: 质检员逐行判定合格 / 不合格。
desc.en: The inspector marks each line pass / fail.

desc.zh: 合格物料转入正式库存，可销售 / 领用。
desc.en: Passed items move to formal stock — sellable/issuable.

desc.zh: 选择退回供应商，或让步接受。
desc.en: Choose to return to the supplier or accept by concession.

desc.zh: 直接拒收退还供应商，不入库，流程终止。
desc.en: Reject and return to the supplier; no receipt; flow ends.

desc.zh: 采购 / 质量主管审批（可能价格折让）。
desc.en: Procurement / QA manager approves (possibly with a price discount).

desc.zh: 以让步接受方式入库，标记让步批次。
desc.en: Receive by concession and flag the concession batch.

desc.zh: 免检 / 合格 / 让步三路汇合，进入可用库存。
desc.en: Exempt / passed / concession paths merge into available stock.

summary.zh: 新建项目选客户 → 关联合同 / 直接关联订单归集并汇总金额 → 配团队立项 → 存续期动态追加 → 进入计划编排启动执行。
summary.en: New project picks a customer → link contracts / orders and aggregate amounts → assign team and launch → add more during the project → enter planning and start execution.

desc.zh: 项目经理在项目管理模块发起新建项目。
desc.en: The PM starts a new project in the project module.

desc.zh: 进入新建页面，准备录入信息与团队。
desc.en: Open the new-project page to enter info and the team.

desc.zh: 录入名称 / 编号 / 类型 / 计划起止 / 业务线。
desc.en: Enter name / code / type / planned dates / business line.

desc.zh: 从客户主数据选对应客户，作过滤依据。
desc.en: Pick the customer from master data as the filter basis.

desc.zh: 关联销售合同（A）或直接关联订单（B）。
desc.en: Link a sales contract (A) or orders directly (B).

check.zh: A 自动归集 / B 手动勾选

desc.zh: 路径 A：勾选客户名下已签合同（多选）。
desc.en: Path A: select the customer's signed contracts (multi-select).

desc.zh: 按合同自动归集全部订单，新增持续追加。
desc.en: Auto-collect all orders by contract; new ones keep appending.

desc.zh: 路径 B：从已确认订单逐项勾选关联。
desc.en: Path B: pick from confirmed orders one by one.

desc.zh: 项目金额 = 关联订单金额合计，实时刷新。
desc.en: Project amount = sum of linked orders, refreshed live.

desc.zh: 指定 1 负责人 + N 成员，按角色授权。
desc.en: Assign 1 owner + N members with role-based access.

desc.zh: 项目建立，状态进行中，可动态扩展。
desc.en: Project is created, status in-progress, expandable.

check.zh: 状态 / 金额 / 清单

desc.zh: 存续期监听客户是否新签合同。
desc.en: During the project, watch for new customer contracts.

desc.zh: 勾选新签合同追加，原有关系不变。
desc.en: Append a newly signed contract; existing links stay.

desc.zh: 新合同订单自动并入项目订单池。
desc.en: Orders from the new contract auto-merge into the pool.

desc.zh: 按新订单合并刷新，变更轨迹可查。
desc.en: Refresh by merging new orders; changes are auditable.

desc.zh: 构建项目执行的时间轴 / 阶段 / 任务体系。
desc.en: Build the timeline / stages / task structure for execution.

desc.zh: 套用模板批量生成，或手动新建。
desc.en: Generate from a template in bulk, or build manually.

desc.zh: 选模板一键批量生成阶段 / 里程碑 / 任务。
desc.en: Pick a template to bulk-create stages / milestones / tasks.

title.zh: 新建阶段 / 里程碑 / 任务

desc.zh: 逐项创建并配依赖 / 负责人 / 起止时间。
desc.en: Create each and set dependencies / owner / dates.

desc.zh: 计划编排完成，进入正式执行。
desc.en: Planning done; enter formal execution.

check.zh: 工时 / 进度 / 回款

summary.zh: 配置时薪（固定费率 / 工资折算）→ 员工填报工时 → 系统校验核算 → 按项目 / 订单归集 → 多维统计分析。
summary.en: Set hourly rates (fixed / salary-derived) → employees log hours → system validates and computes → allocate by project / order → multi-dimensional analysis.

desc.zh: 项目管理员发起员工工时成本配置流程。
desc.en: The project admin starts the labor-cost setup.

desc.zh: 工作台左侧导航选「项目管理」。
desc.en: Pick "Project Management" in the left nav.

desc.zh: 顶部菜单进入配置中心维护规则字典。
desc.en: Open the config center from the top menu to maintain rules.

desc.zh: 进入时薪规则维护页面。
desc.en: Open the hourly-rate rules page.

check.zh: 计算方式 / 适用范围

desc.zh: 固定费率或工资折算，可差异化启用。
desc.en: Fixed rate or salary-derived; can apply selectively.

check.zh: 固定费率 / 工资折算

desc.zh: 按岗位 / 职级设统一时薪，易审计。
desc.en: Set a uniform rate by role / grade; easy to audit.

title.zh: 按岗位 / 职级配置时薪

desc.zh: 为不同岗位 / 职级配统一时薪标准。
desc.en: Set a uniform rate standard per role / grade.

check.zh: 岗位 or 职级为主

desc.zh: 基于历史工资折算时薪，更贴近实际。
desc.en: Derive the rate from historical salary — closer to actual.

desc.zh: 从 HR 模块同步工资记录与标准工时。
desc.en: Sync salary records and standard hours from HR.

check.zh: 工资 / 周期 / 标准工时

desc.zh: 系统按工资 ÷ 标准工时折算基础时薪。
desc.en: System derives base rate = salary ÷ standard hours.

check.zh: 基础时薪 = 工资 ÷ 标准工时

desc.zh: 是否叠加管理费 / 社保等间接成本。
desc.en: Whether to add overhead / benefits and other indirect cost.

check.zh: 是 → 设比例 / 否 → 直接用
check.en: Yes → set rate / No → use as is

desc.zh: 按公司口径设统一叠加比例，可差异化。
desc.en: Set a company-wide overhead rate; can differentiate.

check.zh: 叠加比例 / 适用范围

desc.zh: 基础时薪 ×（1 + 管理成本比例）。
desc.en: Base rate × (1 + overhead rate).

desc.zh: 写入工时成本规则库供核算引擎调用。
desc.en: Save to the rule library for the costing engine.

check.zh: 规则编号 / 生效日期

desc.zh: 按当日进度逐项录入，建议日清日结。
desc.en: Log each item daily; clear-as-you-go is recommended.

desc.zh: 核算源头单据，关联项目 / 订单 / 合同。
desc.en: The source document, linked to project / order / contract.

desc.zh: 提交时校验员工是否有生效时薪配置。
desc.en: On submit, check the employee has an active rate config.

check.zh: 员工 + 日期 + 部门 / 项目

desc.zh: 无配置 → 提示先维护规则，本笔暂不计成本。
desc.en: No config → prompt to set rules; this entry isn't costed yet.

desc.zh: 通过校验 → 按时薪 × 工时自动核算。
desc.en: On pass → auto-compute as rate × hours.

check.zh: 工时成本 = 时薪 × 工时

desc.zh: 按关联字段决定成本归集去向。
desc.en: The link field decides where the cost is allocated.

desc.zh: 计入对应项目人工成本累计。
desc.en: Add to the project's accumulated labor cost.

desc.zh: 计入订单 / 合同人工成本，支撑毛利。
desc.en: Add to order / contract labor cost to support margin.

desc.zh: 项目详情展示总人工成本，可下钻。
desc.en: Project details show total labor cost, drillable.

title.zh: 订单 / 合同维度展示

desc.zh: 订单 / 合同详情展示成本明细与毛利。
desc.en: Order / contract details show cost breakdown and margin.

desc.zh: 项目 × 员工 × 时间多维交叉统计。
desc.en: Cross-stats by project × employee × time.

desc.zh: 配置 → 填报 → 校验 → 核算 → 归集 → 展示闭环。
desc.en: Config → log → validate → compute → allocate → display, a closed loop.

name.zh: 供应商 SN 码管理

summary.zh: 到货扫码录入 SN（唯一性校验）→ 写入中央库「在库」→ 出库扫码绑客户改「已售」→ 售后按 SN 联表判定，防窜货。
summary.en: Scan-in SN at arrival (uniqueness check) → write "in stock" to the central registry → scan-out binds customer and sets "sold" → after-sales decides by SN lookup, preventing diversion.

desc.zh: 经销 / 代理模式启动采购，SN 唯一标识全生命周期。
desc.en: Distributor/agent model starts procurement; SN uniquely tracks the lifecycle.

desc.zh: 指定供应商 / 物料 / 数量，供应商字段为溯源根。
desc.en: Specify supplier / item / quantity; supplier is the trace root.

title.zh: 供应商发货（含 SN 标签）

desc.zh: 出厂前贴附唯一 SN 标签（条码 / 二维码）。
desc.en: Affix a unique SN label (barcode / QR) before shipping.

desc.zh: 新建入库单，关联采购订单与供应商。
desc.en: Create a receipt note linked to the PO and supplier.

desc.zh: 逐行选本次到货物料，确认型号数量。
desc.en: Select arrived items line by line; confirm model and quantity.

desc.zh: 扫码枪逐条录入 SN，多扫 / 漏扫 / 重复均拦截。
desc.en: Scan each SN; over-scan / miss / duplicate are all blocked.

check.zh: 一物一码 · 源头关卡
check.en: One item, one code · Source gate

desc.zh: 查重：是否已存在于 SN 码管理模块。
desc.en: De-dup check against the SN registry.

check.zh: 已存在拒收 / 不存在入库

title.zh: 重复 / 异常 → 重新扫描

desc.zh: SN 重复或不可识别 → 回退重扫，避免污染。
desc.en: Duplicate or unreadable SN → roll back and rescan to avoid pollution.

title.zh: 自动生成 SN 记录

desc.zh: 校验通过 → 为每个 SN 创建记录，状态在库。
desc.en: On pass → create a record per SN with status "in stock".

check.zh: SN / 物料 / 供应商 / 时间

desc.zh: 全生命周期中央库，售后追溯唯一权威源。
desc.en: The lifecycle central registry — the sole authority for after-sales tracing.

check.zh: 物料 / 供应商 / 时间 / 客户 / 状态

desc.zh: 订单确认后建出库单，关联客户与订单。
desc.en: After order confirmation, create an issue note linked to customer and order.

desc.zh: 出库扫码，校验在库且属本订单物料。
desc.en: Scan at issue; verify in stock and belongs to this order.

title.zh: 绑定客户 + 出库时间

desc.zh: 自动绑定客户与出库时间，写回 SN 库。
desc.en: Auto-bind customer and issue time; write back to the registry.

check.zh: 商品 → 客户唯一映射

title.zh: SN 状态：在库 → 已售

desc.zh: 状态切换已售，附客户与出库单引用。
desc.en: Switch status to sold with customer and issue-note refs.

desc.zh: 发运至客户，进入售后保障期。
desc.en: Ship to the customer; the warranty period begins.

desc.zh: 客户凭 SN 码发起售后请求。
desc.en: The customer raises an after-sales request with the SN.

desc.zh: 售后输入 / 扫描 SN，触发联表查询。
desc.en: After-sales enters/scans the SN, triggering a lookup.

desc.zh: 按存在性 / 来源 / 时间轴 / 客户综合判断。
desc.en: Decide by existence / source / timeline / customer.

desc.zh: 本渠道 → 允许维修 / 换货 / 退货，显示完整信息。
desc.en: Own channel → allow repair / exchange / return, with full info.

desc.zh: 不存在 / 非本渠道 → 拒绝或特殊审批，写日志。
desc.en: Unknown / other channel → deny or special approval, logged.

name.zh: 销售合同收入确认方式

summary.zh: 下单时四选一：按出库 / 按验收节点 / 按发票 / 周期性；四路统一汇入收入确认 → 应收生成 → 成本结转。
summary.en: Pick one at order time: by issue / by acceptance milestone / by invoice / periodic; all four converge to revenue recognition → AR creation → cost carry-forward.

desc.zh: 下单环节预选收入确认方式，驱动整条链路。
desc.en: Pre-select the revenue method at ordering; it drives the whole chain.

desc.zh: 录入客户 / 物料 / 金额 / 交期，必填收入确认方式。
desc.en: Enter customer / item / amount / date; revenue method is required.

desc.zh: 四选一：按出库 / 验收节点 / 发票 / 周期性。
desc.en: Pick one: by issue / acceptance / invoice / periodic.

desc.zh: 贸易型：备货拣货扫码绑批次，准备出库。
desc.en: Trading: stock, pick, scan-bind batch, ready to issue.

desc.zh: 过账即扣库存、按 WAC 计成本，联动收入。
desc.en: Posting deducts stock, costs by WAC, and links revenue.

check.zh: 借发出商品 / 贷库存

desc.zh: 出库单过账即自动生成收入确认单。
desc.en: Posting the issue note auto-creates a revenue-recognition doc.

desc.zh: 按出库金额自动生成，待财务审核。
desc.en: Auto-generated by issue amount, pending finance review.

desc.zh: 核对金额 / 税率 / 客户 / 出库批次。
desc.en: Verify amount / tax / customer / issue batch.

check.zh: 通过 → 入账 / 驳回

title.zh: 审核通过 → 收入确认

desc.zh: 正式确认收入，成本同步自动结转。
desc.en: Formally recognize revenue; cost carries forward in sync.

title.zh: ② 配置验收节点 + 比例

desc.zh: 项目型：配多个验收阶段，比例合计 100%。
desc.en: Project: set multiple acceptance stages summing to 100%.

desc.zh: 项目执行至预设验收节点。
desc.en: The project reaches a preset acceptance milestone.

desc.zh: 针对当前节点发起验收申请。
desc.en: Raise an acceptance request for the current milestone.

desc.zh: 上传客户签字验收单 / 交付清单 / 确认邮件。
desc.en: Upload signed acceptance / delivery list / confirmation email.

desc.zh: 核对材料完整真实，比对节点比例。
desc.en: Verify evidence is complete and matches the milestone %.

desc.zh: 按当前节点比例确认对应金额收入。
desc.en: Recognize revenue for the current milestone percentage.

check.zh: 本期收入 = 总额 × 比例

title.zh: ③ 销售发起开票申请

desc.zh: 财务主导：按客户需求发起开票申请。
desc.en: Finance-led: raise an invoice request per customer need.

desc.zh: 开具增值税专 / 普票，金额税率以订单为准。
desc.en: Issue a VAT special/general invoice per the order.

desc.zh: 登记已开发票，关联订单与申请单。
desc.en: Register the issued invoice, linked to order and request.

desc.zh: 发票登记成功即自动生成收入确认记录。
desc.en: Successful registration auto-creates a revenue record.

desc.zh: 按发票金额生成收入确认，一一对应。
desc.en: Create recognition by invoice amount, one-to-one.

check.zh: 收入 = 发票不含税额

desc.zh: 订阅 / 服务：配起止时间与确认周期。
desc.en: Subscription/service: set start-end and the recognition cycle.

desc.zh: 按周期拆解成每期确认计划记录。
desc.en: Split by cycle into per-period recognition records.

check.zh: 每期金额 = 总额 ÷ 期数

desc.zh: 周期到期系统取当期计划触发收入。
desc.en: On due, the system takes the period plan and triggers revenue.

desc.zh: 可选人工审核：启用人工审 / 不启用直确认。
desc.en: Optional manual review: enable review / or recognize directly.

desc.zh: 本期收入入账，计划状态改已确认。
desc.en: Post the period's revenue; the plan status becomes recognized.

check.zh: 本期收入 = 计划金额

desc.zh: 四模式结果统一汇总入账。
desc.en: Results from all four modes converge for booking.

check.zh: 借应收 / 贷收入 + 税金

desc.zh: 总账新增应收余额，进入账龄统计。
desc.en: GL adds the AR balance and starts aging.

desc.zh: 模式① 实时结转，其余月末批量结转。
desc.en: Mode ① carries in real time; others batch at month-end.

desc.zh: 收入 + 应收 + 成本结转完成，进入回款链。
desc.en: Revenue + AR + cost carry done; enters the collection chain.

name.zh: 价格策略与销售定价机制

summary.zh: 四个价格源（基础价 / 价格组 / 协议价 / 特价），下单触发匹配引擎按「特价 > 协议价 > 价格组价 > 基础价」命中即停。
summary.en: Four price sources (base / price group / agreement / special); ordering triggers the engine to match by "special > agreement > group > base", stopping at the first hit.

desc.zh: 价格体系根基，每个 SKU 关联价格属性。
desc.en: The pricing foundation; each SKU carries price attributes.

check.zh: 编码 / 类别 / 价格组

desc.zh: 成本价 / 最低价 / 建议价 / 目录价。
desc.en: Cost / floor / suggested / list price.

desc.zh: 由成本层层推导：Cost → Min → Sug → List。
desc.en: Derive step by step: Cost → Min → Sug → List.

desc.zh: 定义一组物料的统一价格策略。
desc.en: Define a uniform pricing policy for a group of items.

desc.zh: 按产品类型批量或手动选 SKU 加入。
desc.en: Add SKUs in bulk by type or manually.

desc.zh: 应用阶梯规则或固定折扣 / 加价比例。
desc.en: Apply tier rules or a fixed discount / markup rate.

desc.zh: 按类型 / 价格组 / 单物料批量加价降价。
desc.en: Mark up/down in bulk by type / group / single item.

desc.zh: 保存即生效，组内物料按规则计价。
desc.en: Active on save; group items price by the rule.

desc.zh: 对特定客户开放专属价格入口。
desc.en: Open a dedicated price entry for a specific customer.

desc.zh: 选协议适用客户，可多份协议。
desc.en: Pick the customer for the agreement; multiple are allowed.

title.zh: 选适用物料 / 价格组

desc.zh: 指定具体物料或整个价格组。
desc.en: Specify items or an entire price group.

desc.zh: 按基础价 X% 折扣，或绝对固定单价。
desc.en: X% off the base price, or an absolute fixed price.

desc.zh: 按金额 / 折扣幅度走多级审批。
desc.en: Multi-level approval by amount / discount depth.

check.zh: 折扣 / 金额 / 客户等级

desc.zh: 通过后生效，下单自动匹配覆盖默认价。
desc.en: Active on approval; auto-matches at ordering over the default.

check.zh: 适用范围 / 生效区间

desc.zh: 针对单笔订单的特殊定价需求。
desc.en: A special-pricing need for a single order.

desc.zh: 填客户 / 商品 / 特殊价 / 数量 + 理由。
desc.en: Fill customer / item / special price / quantity + reason.

desc.zh: 按特价幅度走多级审批，可能联签。
desc.en: Multi-level approval by discount depth, possibly co-signed.

title.zh: 特价单生效（最高优先级）

desc.zh: 仅对客户 + 商品 + 数量生效，优先级最高。
desc.en: Applies only to customer + item + quantity; highest priority.

desc.zh: 新建订单录入客户与商品，触发匹配引擎。
desc.en: Create an order with customer and items; trigger the engine.

desc.zh: 按 4 级优先级查询价格源。
desc.en: Query price sources by 4 priority levels.

desc.zh: 查客户 + 商品 + 数量有效特价单（优先级 1）。
desc.en: Check a valid special-price doc for customer + item + qty (P1).

check.zh: 客户 + 商品 + 数量

desc.zh: 查客户在商品 / 价格组的协议价（优先级 2）。
desc.en: Check the customer's agreement on item / group (P2).

desc.zh: 查商品所在价格组策略价（优先级 3）。
desc.en: Check the policy price of the item's group (P3).

desc.zh: 强制用特价单价格与数量，不可修改。
desc.en: Force the special-price doc's price and quantity, locked.

desc.zh: 应用协议价覆盖默认，记协议号。
desc.en: Apply the agreement price over default; record the no.

desc.zh: 应用价格组策略价，按规则动态计算。
desc.en: Apply the group's policy price, computed dynamically.

check.zh: 折扣 / 阶梯 / 加价

desc.zh: 兜底退回基础价，通常默认目录价。
desc.en: Fall back to the base price, usually the list price.

desc.zh: 匹配完成进入审批 / 出库，全程可追溯。
desc.en: Matching done; proceed to approval / issue, fully traceable.

summary.zh: 应收四源（出库 / 阶段验收 / 周期 / 发票触发）各按不同时点生成单据，统一汇入收入确认 → 应收挂账 → 收款核销。
summary.en: Four AR sources (issue / staged acceptance / periodic / invoice) create docs at different times, converging to revenue recognition → AR posting → receipt clearing.

title.zh: 应收款 · 四类业务源头

desc.zh: 4 类场景生成应收，触发时点各不同。
desc.en: Four scenarios create AR at different trigger times.

check.zh: 出库 / 验收 / 周期 / 发票

desc.zh: 贸易型：发货过账即触发收入与应收。
desc.en: Trading: posting the shipment triggers revenue and AR.

desc.zh: 项目型：阶段签字验收按比例确认。
desc.en: Project: recognize by % on signed staged acceptance.

desc.zh: 订阅型：按周期到期自动触发。
desc.en: Subscription: auto-trigger on each period due.

desc.zh: 开票登记即触发，不依赖出库 / 验收。
desc.en: Invoice registration triggers it, independent of issue/acceptance.

desc.zh: 过账生成出库单，按 WAC 计成本。
desc.en: Posting creates the issue note, cost by WAC.

check.zh: 借发出商品 / 贷库存

desc.zh: 上传客户签字材料，按本节点比例触发。
desc.en: Upload signed evidence; trigger by this stage's %.

desc.zh: 系统按周期参数拆解 N 期确认计划。
desc.en: System splits into N periodic recognition plans.

desc.zh: 开增值税发票并登记，唯一收入触发点。
desc.en: Issue and register a VAT invoice; the sole revenue trigger.

check.zh: 借应收 / 贷收入 + 税

desc.zh: 四类触发统一记账，均生成应收。
desc.en: All four triggers book uniformly and create AR.

check.zh: 借应收 / 贷收入 + 税金

desc.zh: 应收余额增加，进入账龄与催收。
desc.en: AR balance increases; enters aging and collection.

desc.zh: 按账期付款，可跨发票 / 部分 / 合并。
desc.en: Pay per terms — cross-invoice / partial / merged.

desc.zh: 银企直连 / 回单导入，自动识别去重。
desc.en: Bank link / receipt import with auto de-dup.

check.zh: 客户 / 币种 / 去重

desc.zh: 出纳登记收款单，指定挂应收 / 未指定挂预收。
desc.en: Cashier records the receipt; assigned → AR, unassigned → advance.

check.zh: 借银行 / 贷应收或预收
check.en: Dr bank / Cr AR or advance

desc.zh: 1:1 / 1:N / N:N 核销，尾差入折扣 / 汇兑。
desc.en: 1:1 / 1:N / N:N clearing; residuals to discount / FX.

desc.zh: 挂账 → 付款 → 认款 → 核销全链路完成。
desc.en: Posting → payment → matching → clearing, complete.

summary.zh: 应付四入口（PO / 报销 / 发票触发 / 付款申请）汇入财务审核分流，按员工 / 外部科目路由后付款核销；辨析报销 vs 付款申请。
summary.en: Four AP entries (PO / reimbursement / invoice / payment request) flow into finance review and routing, paid and cleared by employee/external accounts; distinguishes reimbursement vs payment request.

title.zh: 应付款 · 四类业务源头

desc.zh: 4 类场景触发应付，对象与触发点不同。
desc.en: Four scenarios create AP with different payees and triggers.

check.zh: PO / 报销 / 发票 / 付款申请

desc.zh: 有合同有 PO，到货形成应付货款。
desc.en: With contract and PO, arrival forms a goods payable.

desc.zh: 员工先垫付再报销，公司还员工。
desc.en: Employee pays first, then reimburses; the company repays them.

desc.zh: 无 PO，收到供应商发票即挂应付。
desc.en: No PO; a supplier invoice posts AP on receipt.

desc.zh: 公司直接对外付款，员工不出钱。
desc.en: The company pays externally; employees pay nothing.

title.zh: ① 房租 / 水电 / 物业

desc.zh: 周期经营成本，凭账单 / 合同直付。
desc.en: Recurring operating cost, paid directly by bill / contract.

check.zh: 借管理费用 / 贷应付

desc.zh: 未达起 PO 门槛的小额采购，直付供应商。
desc.en: Small purchases below the PO threshold, paid to supplier directly.

check.zh: 借管理费用 / 贷应付

title.zh: ③ 工资 / 社保 / 公积金

desc.zh: 对公强制支付，HR 提交财务统一发放。
desc.en: Mandatory corporate payments; HR submits, finance disburses.

check.zh: 借应付职工薪酬 / 贷银行

title.zh: ④ 税款 / 银行手续费

desc.zh: 对公强制缴纳，财务发起付款申请。
desc.en: Mandatory corporate payments; finance raises a payment request.

check.zh: 借应交税费 / 财务费用

desc.zh: 供应商发货入库收票，三单匹配确认应付。
desc.en: Supplier ships, receipt and invoice arrive; three-way match confirms AP.

desc.zh: 粘贴票据分类填报，主管 → 财务多级审批。
desc.en: Attach receipts, categorize, then manager → finance approval.

check.zh: 借费用 / 贷其他应付-员工

desc.zh: 录入发票号 / 税率 / 金额，关联合同服务。
desc.en: Enter invoice no. / tax / amount, linked to contract/service.

check.zh: 借费用 / 贷应付账款

desc.zh: 填收款单位 / 金额 / 用途，附凭证待审付款。
desc.en: Fill payee / amount / purpose with proof, pending approval.

title.zh: 财务审核 + 科目分流

desc.zh: 核对单据凭证金额，按类型分流应付科目。
desc.en: Verify docs and amount; route AP accounts by type.

check.zh: 报销 → 员工 / 其余 → 外部

title.zh: 报销 vs 付款申请 区别

desc.zh: 严格区分：报销还员工 / 付款申请直付外部。
desc.en: Strictly separate: reimbursement repays employees / payment request pays external.

title.zh: 应付职工 / 其他应付-员工

desc.zh: 应付对象 = 员工，仅报销走此科目。
desc.en: Payee = employee; only reimbursement uses this account.

title.zh: 应付账款 / 其他应付款

desc.zh: 应付对象 = 外部，PO / 发票 / 付款申请走此科目。
desc.en: Payee = external; PO / invoice / payment request use this account.

desc.zh: 按金额 / 对象 / 用途走多级审批。
desc.en: Multi-level approval by amount / payee / purpose.

check.zh: 金额 / 用途 / 紧急度

desc.zh: 银企直连 / 网银 / 现金付款，分员工卡 / 对公。
desc.en: Pay via bank link / online banking / cash, to employee card / corporate.

desc.zh: 生成付款单，记时间 / 金额 / 收款方 / 关联单据。
desc.en: Create the voucher with time / amount / payee / linked docs.

desc.zh: 付款单与应付单据核销，余额减少。
desc.en: Clear the voucher against payables; balance decreases.

desc.zh: 挂账 → 审批 → 付款 → 核销全链路完成。
desc.en: Posting → approval → payment → clearing, complete.
